scope: Google Search Console only (93 snapshots, 2026-05-07 to 2026-08-20) joined to the 83-keyword tracker in keywords-master.json. wins: Bariatric core terms hold page-1: 'bariatric therapy' at position 1.0, 'bariatric counseling' at 3.4, 'bariatric therapist' at 5.0 and 'bariatric counselor' at 5.7 — 2 of 18 ranked keywords sit in the #1-#3 tiers and 3 more in #4-10.

'bariatric counseling' is the standout trend line: 25.0 in the 2026-05-07 reference snapshot, 17.8 on 2026-07-05, 3.4 today — with 11 impressions behind it, the strongest sustained climb in the tracked set.

The two highest-volume San Antonio eating-disorder terms both moved up this run: 'eating disorder counseling san antonio' 14.5 to 12.9 (delta +1.6, 14 impressions) and 'eating disorder therapist san antonio' 15.0 to 13.7 (delta +1.3, 13 impressions); both were near 24 in early July.

Blog content is carrying impression volume at page-1 positions: the hydration post has accumulated 7,140 impressions and 25 clicks at avg position 7.1 across the snapshot window, the GLP-1 medications explainer 1,267 impressions at 10.6, and the sleep-and-metabolism post 1,036 at 12.1.
Day-over-day the latest snapshot improved: impressions 1,593 to 1,729 and impression-weighted average position 17.96 to 17.66 versus the 2026-08-19 run.
needs_attention: Coverage: 18 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show GSC impressions; 65 show none. This is a KEYWORD count, not a page count and not a count of unpublished pages — the 83 keywords map to only 50 distinct target pages, and 49 of those 50 are live www URLs. Tracker hygiene is in good shape: exactly 1 distinct targetUrl still points at staging (staging12 /what-is-a-bariatric-counselor/), and past checks showed staging-targeted tracker URLs are usually stale pointers to pages already live, not missing pages.

Long-run visibility is down while clicks are up: impressions fell from 2,447 on the 2026-05-07 snapshot to 1,729 on 2026-08-20 (-29%) and impression-weighted average position worsened from 14.87 to 17.66, even as clicks rose from 2 to 12. Net: fewer eyeballs, better conversion of them.
CTR is near zero: 12 clicks on 1,729 impressions in the latest snapshot is 0.69%. The hydration post alone is 7,140 cumulative impressions for 25 clicks (0.35%) — high ranking, weak click capture.

'bariatric counseling near me' is the biggest slip of the run: 6.8 to 34.5 (delta -27.8) on 8 impressions — a commercial-intent, bottom-of-funnel term that fell off page 1 entirely. 'bariatric surgery counseling' also dropped 9.3 to 15.6 (delta -6.3, 5 impressions).

'bariatric psychological evaluation near me' carries the most impressions of any tracked term (28) but slipped 24.0 to 28.7 (delta -4.7) and sits on page 3 — the largest gap between demand and position in the set. Distribution shifted the wrong way overall: the #11-20 tier went from 7 terms yesterday to 4, with 21+ rising from 6 to 9.
priority_actions: Fix the CTR problem first — it is the highest-leverage move given positions are already page-1. Rewrite title tags and meta descriptions on the four biggest impression earners (hydration, GLP-1 medications explainer, sleep/metabolism, gastroparesis) and add an explicit above-the-fold CTA plus contextual internal links from each into the matching service page (bariatric surgery counseling, weight-loss counseling, eating-disorder treatment).

Run an on-page refresh for the two slipped commercial terms: 'bariatric counseling near me' (6.8 to 34.5) and 'bariatric surgery counseling' (9.3 to 15.6). Check for cannibalization between the near-me/geo variants and the core /bariatric-surgery-counseling-in-san-antonio-tx/ page before adding new content — a collision is the likeliest explanation for a 28-position drop.

Build out 'bariatric psychological evaluation near me' — 28 impressions at position 28.7 is the clearest demand-to-position gap. Deepen the evaluation page (what the eval covers, insurance, turnaround, who signs off) and link to it from the bariatric surgery counseling page.

Tracker hygiene: repoint the one remaining staging targetUrl (/what-is-a-bariatric-counselor/) to its live www equivalent, and add targetUrls for the 2 keywords currently missing one, so GSC can match. If a staging-to-production push backlog is a real concern, confirm the actual push list via a staging-vs-prod sitemap diff or Daniel's own notes — it cannot be inferred from GSC or keyword data and no count is asserted here.

Defend the core: 'bariatric therapy' (#1), 'bariatric counseling' (3.4), 'bariatric therapist' (5.0) and 'bariatric counselor' (5.7) are the franchise. Add FAQ schema to those service pages for rich-result and AI-overview eligibility, and keep them refreshed. Competitor #1-blocker and AI-visibility checks still need a manual pass — GSC shows none of it.
summary: 18 of 83 tracked keywords show GSC impressions; the bariatric core holds page-1 (therapy #1, counseling 3.4) and San Antonio eating-disorder terms improved, but sitewide impressions are down 29% since 2026-05-07 with average position sliding 14.87 to 17.66 and CTR at 0.69%. The priority is click capture on already-ranking blog content plus an on-page fix for 'bariatric counseling near me', which fell from 6.8 to 34.5.
